Card Q&A.a: Yes, you must add as many cards to your hand and place as bottom digivolution cards as possible.
Card Q&A.q: If cards that are targets of this effect are revealed from the deck, do I have to add as many cards to my hand and place as bottom digivolution cards as possible?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Among them, add 1 card with [Vemmon] in its text to the hand and place 1 [Vemmon] as any of your Digimon's bottom digivolution card. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve into a Digimon card with [Vemmon] in its text, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
